usedFor: Notion holds your pages, and MeisterTask turns each new page into work through “Create Task”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Page Is Created” in Notion, then “Create Task” in MeisterTask
bestTemplate.why: A new Notion page becomes a MeisterTask task, so planning notes get an owner and a place.

watchOut: “New Page Is Created” in Notion is pushed, but “Create Task” still needs a project and section chosen.
